data.one_liner: CRED's NeoPop design system library for Flutter widgets and buttons.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized NeoPop design components such as elevated buttons, flat buttons, tilted buttons, and shimmer effects built for Flutter applications.
use_when: You want to implement CRED's NeoPop design system in your app
You need stylized buttons with custom depth, shadows, and click animations
avoid_when: You need standard Material Design or Cupertino widgets
You require a comprehensive multi-platform design framework beyond specific button components
strengths: Ready-to-use NeoPop UI components like NeoPopButton and NeoPopTiltedButton
Customizable surfaces, shadows, depths, and shimmer effects
weaknesses: Limited to a very specific design system style
data.minimal_example:
NeoPopButton(
    color: Colors.white,
    onTapUp: () => HapticFeedback.vibrate(),
    onTapDown: () => HapticFeedback.vibrate(),
    child: Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 15),
        child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
                Text("Pay now"),
            ],
        ),
    ),
)
